## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does. Link the issue if applicable.

## Verification

Describe tests/checks actually run, including results. Identify mocked testing versus physical hardware testing. For UI changes, include before/after images.

## Risks and limitations

Describe compatibility concerns, remaining limitations, and any changes to device commands, privacy, or automatic execution.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Logs/examples contain no credentials or private network identifiers.
- [ ] Unknown or transmitting commands cannot run automatically.
- [ ] Optional dependencies remain optional.
- [ ] Existing license notices and third-party attributions are preserved.
